text: @mojiexuan/dsh-git 是面向 DSH Web 的 Git 源代码管理插件，在界面中提供可切换的侧栏面板，跟随当前会话的工作区显示仓库状态。它支持初始化仓库、逐文件暂存与取消暂存、提交并推送或拉取、管理分支和远端、浏览提交历史图，也能根据变更生成 Conventional Commits 风格的中文提交说明。面板可停靠在详情栏或在窄屏时浮动显示，适合希望直接在 DSH 工作区处理 Git 操作的开发者。使用 AI 提交说明需要 DSH 配置的模型服务；版本检查会访问 npm registry。

@mojiexuan/dsh-git adds Git controls to DSH Web: initialize repositories, stage files, commit, sync remotes, manage branches, and view commit history. It generates Chinese commit messages through the configured model. The panel docks or floats on narrow screens.

@mojiexuan/dsh-git 的功能「逐文件暂存与撤销」：面板按已暂存和未暂存状态列出文件，用户可逐项暂存或撤销，也可批量处理全部变更。通过 Git 面板触发，作用于当前会话的工作区。
@mojiexuan/dsh-git 的功能「提交与远端同步」：用户可在面板提交工作区变更，并根据分支状态推送或发布分支；有远端时还可拉取更新。通过 Git 面板触发，作用于当前会话的工作区。
@mojiexuan/dsh-git 的功能「分支和远端管理」：面板支持查看、切换、创建或删除分支，并添加或移除远端仓库。通过 Git 面板触发，作用于当前会话的工作区。
@mojiexuan/dsh-git 的功能「提交历史图」：提交历史以图形方式展示，并通过分页加载历史记录，方便查看分支和提交关系。通过 Git 面板触发，作用于当前会话的工作区。
@mojiexuan/dsh-git sends diffs to the configured model, capped at 4000 characters. (src/host/commit-message.ts:123-139)
@mojiexuan/dsh-git 打开面板后会检查 npm registry 上的插件版本；默认请求 registry.npmjs.org，也可配置 registryUrl。（见 src/host/update.ts:60-76）

@mojiexuan/dsh-git README · @mojiexuan/dsh-git：A VS Code–like **Git Source Control panel** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web UI — repo init, per-file staging, commit/push/publish/pull, branch & remote management, AI commit messages, and a commit-history graph, all in the browser.

> 中文文档：[docs/README.zh.md](docs/README.zh.md)

@mojiexuan/dsh-git README · Features：- **Toggleable panel** — an entry above Settings in the sidebar foot opens/closes the panel.
- **Repo detect & init** — a non-repo workspace shows a one-click "Initialize Git repository" (`git init -b main`).
- **Per-file staging** — collapsible "Staged changes" / "Changes" lists with per-file `+`/`−`, plus stage-all / unstage-all.
- **Git-semantic action button** — "Commit" when there are uncommitted changes (auto-stages if nothing is staged), "Push" when the branch tracks a remote and is ahead, "Publish branch" when the branch has no upstream but has local commits.
- **Pull** — one click to fetch the latest from all remotes and branches (`git fetch --all --prune`); shown only when a remote is configured.
- **Branch management** — list / switch / create / delete (with confirmation).
- **Remote management** — show / add / remove the origin remote (with confirmation).
- **AI commit messages** — streaming, Conventional Commits, generated from the staged/working diff via the harness LLM (Chinese output by default).
- **Commit-history graph** — a lazily-paged SVG lane graph of all branches + remotes (lane topology computed client-side, rounded bends

@mojiexuan/dsh-git README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @mojiexuan/dsh-git
```

Then start `dsh web`.

@mojiexuan/dsh-git README · Build from source：```sh
npm install
npm run build       # lib/index.js (host) + lib/client.js (client)
npm run typecheck
```

@mojiexuan/dsh-git README · Configuration：Optional overrides in your profile `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: git
  config:
    maxDiffChars: 4000     # cap on the diff text sent to the model (default 4000)
    maxLogEntries: 2000    # max commits per page for the history graph (default 2000; scroll to load more)

@mojiexuan/dsh-git README · Structure：```
src/
├── shared/rpc.ts             # endpoint names + DTOs, shared by both halves
├── host/                     # Node half
│   ├── index.ts              # git/* RPC endpoints (loopback-only)

@mojiexuan/dsh-git README · Security：- All `git/*` endpoints are registered with `authority: 'loopback'` (127.0.0.1 only).
- User data is never interpolated into command strings — messages go via `git commit -F -`, paths via `--pathspec-from-file=-`, and branch/remote names and URLs are validated against safe character classes.

@mojiexuan/dsh-git README · Publish：```sh
npm publish
```
